content: Sedesiɑsin bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ nnɛse te sɔɔ, yen suru nɔɔbuse sɔɔ, Hɑnɑniɑ, Asurin bii, wi u sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Gɑbɑoniɔ, u kɑ Yeremi ɡɑri kuɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ tɔmbu kpuron wuswɑɑɔ, Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
U nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ Gusunɔ, Isirelibɑn Yinni wi u wɔllu kɑ tem mɔ u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, u koo wiɡibu yɑrɑ Bɑbiloniɡibun yorun di, te tɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe suɡu ben wĩinɔ.
N kɑ ko wɔ̃ɔ yiru u koo de Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ u kɑ wi, Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun dendi yɑ̃ɑ ni wurɑmɑ, ni u rɑɑ ɡurɑ u kɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ.
U koo mɑɑ de Yoyɑkini, Yoyɑkimun bii, Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko u wurɑmɑ, kɑ sere Yudɑbɑn tɔn be bɑ kɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ. Domi u koo bu yɑrɑ Bɑbilonin yorun di.
Yerɑ Yeremi u Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Hɑnɑniɑ wisɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ tɔn be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yeru mi kpuron wuswɑɑɔ,
u nɛɛ, ɑmi. Gusunɔ u de yu koorɑ nɡe mɛ ɑ ɡeruɑ. Kpɑ u de tɔn be kpuro bu wurɑmɑ Bɑbilonin di kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun dendi yɑ̃ɑ ni.
Adɑmɑ Hɑnɑniɑ, ɑ ɡɑri yini swɑɑ dɑkio ɑ nɔ, yi nɑ ɡerumɔ wunɛn wuswɑɑɔ kɑ tɔn ben wuswɑɑɔ.
Gusunɔn sɔmɔ be bɑ ɡbiɑ bɑ nɑ yellun di, sɑ sere nɑ, nɔni swɑ̃ɑru kɑ tɑbu kɑ bɑrɑnun ɡɑriyɑ bɑ bwese bɑkɑnu kɑ sinɑ bokobu sɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Tɛ̃ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ ɡoo ù n seewɑ u bɔri yɛndun ɡɑri mɔ̀, ɑmɔnɑ tɔmbɑ koo kɑ tubu mɑ Gusunɔwɑ u yɛ̃ro ɡɔrimɑ, mɑ n kun mɔ ye u ɡeruɑ mi, yɑ koorɑ.
Yerɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Hɑnɑniɑ u Yeremi suɡu ye wunɑ mɑ u ye bɔɔkɑ.
Mɑ u tɔmbu kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, n kɑ ko wɔ̃ɔ yiru u koo Bɑbiloniɡibun dɑm mɛ buɑ nɡe mɛ nɑ suɡu ye bɔɔkɑ. Mɑ Yeremi u win swɑɑ mwɑ u n doonɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Hɑnɑniɑ u suɡu dɑ̃ɑ ye wunɑ Yeremin wĩirun di u bɔɔkɑ u kpɑ, yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Yeremi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑ doo ɑ Hɑnɑniɑ sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, u kpĩɑ u suɡu dɑ̃ɑɡiɑ ye bɔɔkɑ, ɑdɑmɑ u koo yen kɔsire wɑ ye yɑ sɑ̃ɑ sisuɡiɑ.

Nɛ Gusunɔ, Isirelibɑn Yinni, nɛ wi nɑ wɔllu kɑ tem mɔ, nɑ nɛɛ, wee nɑ suɡu sisuɡiɑ dokemɔ bwese ni kpuron wĩinɔ, kpɑ nu kɑ Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ, Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko yoru diiyɑ. Bɑɑ kɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛyɔ, kon nùn ye nɔmu bɛriɑwɑ.
Yerɑ Yeremi u Hɑnɑniɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ swɑɑ dɑkio ɑ nɔ, Yinni Gusunɔ kun nun ɡɔre. Kɑ mɛ, ɑ dɑ ɑ tɔmbu ɡɑri weesuɡii sɔ̃ɔwɑ, mɑ bɑ yi nɑɑnɛ kuɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, tɛ̃, wee ye Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, u koo nun wunɑ tem minin di, domi wunɛn ɡɑri yi derɑ tɔmbɑ nùn seesi. Kɑɑ ɡbi ɡisɔku ɡe.
Mɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Hɑnɑniɑ wi, u ɡu wɔ̃ɔ ɡen suru nɔɔbɑ yiruse sɔɔ.
Yeremi u Yudɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ
